title: RefCounted cant assign {} to autoload statically typed dictionary variable
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in v4.7.2.stable.steam [ed1daf0bf] ### System information Godot v4.7.2.stable (ed1daf0bf) - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.16.1074) - AMD Ryzen 5 8645HS w/ Radeon 760M Graphics (12 threads) - 7.30 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description I cant assign default Dictionary value from my RefCounted Script, which is {} to my Statically Typed Dicitonary() in Global Autoload script that extends from Node. Error, No C++ source reference is available for this error. ``` E 0:00:00:785 run_global: Invalid assignment of property or key 'data' with value of type 'Dictionary' on a base object of type 'Node (global.gd)'. data_mapper.gd:11 @ run_global() data_mapper.gd:11 @ run_global() main.gd:12 @ _ready() ``` The Statically Typed Dictionary ```gdscript var data: Dictionary[StringName, int] = {} ``` Whether the function in RefCounted script is static or not, it still cant assign it. But assigning non {} value still possible, like {&"cat": 0}. ```gdscript static func change_global() -> void: Global.data = {&"cat": 0} ``` ### Steps to reproduce Main script ```gdscript extends Node var local_data: Dictionary = {} var target_data: Dictionary = {} func _ready() -> void: DataMapper.run(local_data, target_data) DataMapper.change_other() DataMapper.change_global() print(Global.data) DataMapper.run_global(local_data) print(Global.data) ``` DataMapper script ```gdscript extends RefCounted class_name DataMapper static func run(data: Dictionary, target_data: Dictionary) -> void: target_data = dict_or_default(data, &"data", {}) static func change_global() -> void: Global.data = {&"cat": 0} static func run_global(data: Dictionary) -> void: Global.data = dict_or_default(data, &"data", {}) static func dict_or_default(source: Dictionary, key: StringName, fallback: Dictionary) -> Dictionary: var value: Variant = source.get(key) if value is Dictionary: return value return fallback static func change_other() -> void: Global.array_data = [] Global.string_data = "" ``` Global Autoload Script ```gdscript extends Node var data: Dictionary[StringName, int] = {} var array_data: Array = [] var string_data: String = "" ``` ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [typed-dictionary.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32229502/typed-dictionary.zip)
